privacy.heading: Privacy Policy & KVKK Disclosure

s1.heading: 1. Data Controller
s1.body: This privacy notice is issued under article 10 of Turkish Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK") and the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles for Fulfilling the Obligation to Inform, to tell you about the personal data processed through the nexagrant.com website and the {brand} platform (the "Platform"). The same principles apply to users within the scope of the EU General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR").

address.label: Address

s2.heading: 2. Personal Data We Process
s2.body: Depending on how you use the Platform, the following categories of data may be processed.

visitorSecurity.examples: IP address, browser and device information, server logs, date/time of visit

visitorAnalytics.examples: A random anonymous per-browser identifier and in-product event names (only with your cookie consent; no name, email or page address is sent)

memberContact.examples: Email address, organisation name and province

memberProfessional.examples: Organisation, role, areas of expertise, EU project experience and programmes, organisational capacity descriptions

memberTransaction.examples: Project ideas, application drafts, call preferences and saved searches, documents you upload, AI-generated text, feedback, requests

paidFinance.examples: Invoice details (including tax ID / national ID number), payment records (card details are not stored by {brand}; they are processed by the payment provider)

leadForm.examples: Name, email, organisation, province and district, scorecard result; an irreversible digest of the IP address to prevent abuse

expertPrereg.examples: Name, email, province, title/organisation, areas of expertise, project roles, programme experience, ORCID, LinkedIn profile address, working languages; an irreversible digest of the IP address

s2.note: The Platform does not ask for special categories of personal data (health, religion, ethnic origin, biometric data, etc.). Please do not include such data in the documents you upload.

s3.heading: 3. Purposes and Legal Bases
s3.body: Your personal data is processed only for the purposes below and on the legal bases in KVKK article 5. Explicit consent is required only for the activities in the last three rows.

account.purpose: Opening and managing your account, invitations and team management
account.basis: art.5/2(c) — Formation and performance of a contract

matching.purpose: Matching EU funding calls, providing the project preparation modules, file and evidence storage

aiProcessing.purpose: AI-assisted text generation, document embedding and search, usage logging

expertPool.purpose: Taking an expert pre-registration and verifying the email address

support.purpose: Handling requests, complaints, feedback and support

billing.purpose: Invoicing, accounting and statutory record-keeping (including tax ID / national ID)
billing.basis: art.5/2(ç) — Legal obligation; art.5/2(a) — Expressly provided by law

trafficLogs.purpose: Keeping traffic/log records under Law No. 5651; audit trail

legalClaims.purpose: Establishing, exercising or defending rights in legal disputes (approval workflow records are kept for this purpose even after account deletion)
legalClaims.basis: art.5/2(e) — Establishment, exercise or protection of a right

improvement.purpose: Improving the Platform using anonymous statistics

analytics.purpose: Measuring product usage with analytics storage

leadRequest.purpose: Contacting you through the funding readiness scorecard contact form
leadRequest.basis: art.5/1 — Explicit consent (tick box on the form); art.5/2(f) for the IP digest

expertDirectory.purpose: Showing an expert profile to organisations once the directory goes live

s4.heading: 4. How We Collect Data
s4.body: Your personal data is collected by wholly or partly automated means:

items.forms: Information you enter in the registration, profile, project, funding readiness scorecard and expert pre-registration forms
items.uploads: Project documents and files you upload
items.contact: Information you send through a contact form or by email
items.cookies: Cookies, browser storage and server logs
items.google: If you use Sign in with Google, the name and email address Google passes to us within the scope you allow
items.automated: Results produced by the AI-assisted scoring system

s5.heading: 5. Transfers of Personal Data
s5.body: Your personal data is never sold. It may be transferred only to the recipients below, limited to the purpose and proportionate to it.

domestic.experts: Your expert profile: only if you give explicit consent to publish it in the directory and once the directory goes live, to organisations that are members of the Platform (for project partnership and consultancy matching)
domestic.advisors: Accounting, financial advisory and legal advisory service providers
domestic.authorities: Competent public authorities and courts (on request, under a legal obligation)
domestic.hosting: Vulut (Türkiye): database, application server and email hosting

s5.abroadHeading: Transfers abroad (KVKK art.9, as amended by Law No. 7499):
s5.abroadBody: The Platform uses service providers with servers outside Türkiye for the following services:

anthropic.data: Text you submit for AI-assisted text generation and pre-assessment (capacity descriptions, proposal drafts, documents under evaluation)

google.data: When you sign in with Google you are redirected to your Google account; Google processes the fact that you sign in to the Platform and your connection data. Name and email come from Google to the Platform (section 4)

stripe.data: Customer identifier and billing status for subscription and payment management; the email, card and billing details you enter directly with Stripe on its payment page (subject to Stripe's own privacy notice)

posthog.data: Event names and an anonymous browser identifier (only with cookie consent); your IP address reaches PostHog as part of the connection, location lookup is turned off

s5.safeguards: These transfers are subject to KVKK article 9. The safeguard relied on for each recipient: [CROSS-BORDER TRANSFER MECHANISM — LEGAL CONFIRMATION]. Please send any questions about transfers abroad to info@nexagrant.com.
s5.ownTransfer: In EU project applications, information passed on your instructions, as the applicant, to the European Commission portal (Funding & Tenders) or to your project partners is a transfer made by you. {brand} does not submit applications to the portal on your behalf.

s6.heading: 6. Retention, Disposal and Security
s6.body: Data is kept for as long as the purpose of processing requires and the law prescribes; at the end of that period it is deleted, destroyed or anonymised.

account.period: For the life of the account; permanently deleted 30 days after you request deletion (you can cancel within that window)

invoices.period: 10 years (Turkish Commercial Code No. 6102 art.82, Tax Procedure Law No. 213)

leads.period: {months} months from the day the request was left

expertPrereg.period: {months} months from the day the form was first submitted (unverified registrations included)

teamInvites.period: {days} days after acceptance or after the invitation link expires

records.data: Audit records and the AI usage log
records.period: Indefinitely; when your account is deleted, the link between these records and your identity is removed or replaced with a one-way digest

browser.period: Sign-in cookie 30 days (renewed as you use the site); language preference cookie for the browser session; theme cookie 1 year; temporary cookies during invitation and sign-up steps 15–30 minutes; your cookie choice, cart contents and the anonymous analytics identifier (browser storage) until they are cleared from your browser

s6.disposal: Expired records are deleted by automated jobs that run every night. If you delete your account, data that is not subject to a statutory retention duty is deleted at the end of the 30-day waiting period.
s6.securityBody: Tenant data is separated at the application layer: queries that access tenant data are restricted to your tenant identifier; a defined, limited set of system operations (platform administration, data-subject requests, scheduled jobs) may operate across tenants. PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) policies are defined in the database, but they are not in effect on the application's database connection. Uploaded files are stored in encrypted cloud object storage (R2/S3).

s7.heading: 7. Cookies
s7.body: The Platform uses essential cookies and browser storage without asking, because the service needs them to work; it uses analytics storage only if you choose "Accept all" in the cookie banner. The Platform does not use marketing or advertising cookies. Non-essential storage is off by default.

essential.purpose: Session, security, language preference (TR/EN), theme choice (1 year), cart contents (browser storage), recording your cookie choice, 15–30 minute temporary cookies during invitation and sign-up steps

analytics.purpose: Anonymous product usage statistics (PostHog, EU region)

s7.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time by clearing this site's data in your browser; the cookie banner is shown again on your next visit.

s8.heading: 8. Your Rights and How to Apply
s8.body: Under KVKK article 11 (and the GDPR, where it applies to you), you can apply to {brand} to exercise the following rights:

rights.r1: To learn whether your personal data is processed
rights.r2: To request information if it has been processed — you can export your data as JSON from 'Settings → Privacy & My Data'
rights.r3: To learn the purpose of processing and whether the data is used in line with it
rights.r4: To know the third parties in Türkiye or abroad to whom it has been transferred
rights.r5: To request correction if it is incomplete or inaccurate
rights.r6: To request erasure or destruction under KVKK article 7 — you can request account deletion from 'Settings → Privacy & My Data' (your account is closed immediately and permanently deleted after 30 days; you can cancel within that window)
rights.r7: To request that the actions under items 5 and 6 be notified to the third parties the data was transferred to
rights.r8: To object to an outcome against you that results solely from automated analysis (in-product scoring falls within this right)
rights.r9: To claim compensation if you suffer damage from unlawful processing

s8.exportNote: For security, authentication secrets (OAuth and session tokens) are excluded from exports.
s8.howBody: Under the Communiqué on the Procedures and Principles of Applications to the Data Controller, send your application in Turkish, with your name, Turkish ID number (for foreign nationals: nationality and passport/ID number), address for notifications, email and phone if any, and the subject of your request, by one of the following means:

channels.post: A wet-signed letter, in person or through a notary: Kadıköy Mahallesi No:55, İlkadım / SAMSUN, Türkiye
channels.esign: Secure electronic signature or mobile signature: info@nexagrant.com
channels.email: From the email address registered on the Platform: info@nexagrant.com

s8.response: Applications are answered free of charge within 30 days at the latest. If the action involves an additional cost, the fee in the Board's tariff may be charged. You can exercise these rights even if you do not have an account when you apply.
s8.complaint: If your application is rejected, you find the answer insufficient, or no answer is given in time, you may complain to the Personal Data Protection Board within 30 days of learning the answer and in any case within 60 days of your application.

s9.heading: 9. Explicit Consent and Effective Date
s9.body: The Platform asks for your explicit consent only for the activities below, separately from this notice and with nothing pre-ticked. Membership does not depend on giving any of them.

consents.analytics: Analytics storage: by choosing "Accept all" in the cookie banner
consents.lead: Funding readiness scorecard contact form: by the tick box on the form
consents.expert: Publishing an expert profile in the directory: by the consent in the expert pre-registration

s9.withdraw: You can withdraw your explicit consent at any time by writing to info@nexagrant.com and, for analytics storage, also as described in section 7. Withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing before it.
s9.effective: This notice is effective from [EFFECTIVE DATE]. Changes take effect when published on the site; for material changes the effective date on this page is updated.

terms.heading: Terms of Service and Agreement
terms.scopeBody: {brand} provides a cloud-based grant proposal-writing platform powered by artificial intelligence to institutional customers. The service includes project management (G0–G2 gates), pipeline analytics, concept note drafting and team management. A user account is created via Google OAuth; profile information may be updated. Team members are invited by workspace administrators; seat limits are defined by the subscription plan. Invited users join via the link sent to their email address.
terms.contentBody: Documents uploaded by users (evidence, concept notes, budget spreadsheets) remain the property of the user and their institution. {brand} processes this content to provide the service and may transmit it to AI systems (Anthropic, OpenAI) under a limited license for that purpose only. Data processing details are described in the privacy policy. Users are responsible for copyright compliance of uploaded content.
terms.acceptableUseBody: The service may be used only for lawful and business purposes. Prohibited conduct includes: (a) circumventing technical limits intended to protect the service, (b) accessing the system without permission or accessing another user's data, (c) overloading the system to disrupt other users, (d) uploading content that infringes intellectual property or copyright, (e) uploading content that violates applicable law. {brand} may suspend or terminate accounts in violation of these terms.
terms.billingBody: Subscription fees are charged at the beginning of each billing period. Current plans include Basic, Pro and Ultra. A lifetime license option (no annual renewal) is available for the first 20 entities. AI credits are defined per plan and renew monthly. Promotional codes and campaign coupons are subject to separate terms.
terms.refundBody: A 14-day money-back guarantee applies to subscription purchases. The guarantee includes purchases made with lifetime licenses and coupons. To request a refund, please contact info@nexagrant.com.
terms.trialBody: When a workspace is created, pilot (trial) access is granted for a limited time. After the pilot expires, new calculations and changes are paused. To continue, your workspace administrator must set up a subscription.
terms.terminationBody: Subscriptions may be cancelled anytime via the portal. When you request account deletion, the account is immediately closed and your personal account information is permanently deleted after 30 days. Workspace content, projects and documents remain in the system until the workspace itself is deleted. Billing and audit records are retained; the link to your user identifier in them is removed or replaced with a one-way hash. Free-text fields in audit records may still contain personal data. You may withdraw your deletion request during this 30-day period. For details, see the Privacy Policy §3.
terms.agencyBody: Proposal-writing consultants (agencies) may reach their clients via an invitation code. Users who sign up with an invite code link their workspace to the agency. This linkage does not grant the agency access to the workspace's data; the relationship is established only at registration.
terms.partnerBody: A project lead may share a one-time portal link with consortium partners to contribute budget lines. Partners may add budget lines to the project via the link. Portal access depends on the validity of the link.
terms.intellectualPropertyBody: System design, software and documentation are the intellectual property of {brand}. Although user-uploaded content is transmitted to AI systems for processing, rights to the output belong to the user. Users may use content obtained through the service for any business or commercial purpose.
terms.changesBody: These terms may be modified at any time. The date and version of any change to these terms are recorded. New registrations are subject to the current terms.
terms.contactBody: For questions about the service, please contact {brand} at info@nexagrant.com. Complaints may be submitted in writing to our contact details.

gaps.pic: Register your organisation on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal and get a PIC. Registration is free; validation can take weeks, so start it first.
gaps.lear: Appoint the person who represents your organisation on the portal as LEAR and upload the required documents.
gaps.signatory: Decide who signs the application and the grant agreement, and prepare the written mandate (e.g. a council decision) in advance.
gaps.projectUnit: Make at least one person responsible for EU projects and send them to National Agency or development agency trainings.
gaps.englishWriting: Name the person who writes the application in English, or plan budget and time for writing support.
gaps.pastProjects: Build experience with a small national grant or an easy EU programme (e.g. a town-twinning project).
gaps.cofinancing: Calculate the share the grant does not cover and put it in your budget; most programmes require it.
gaps.cashflow: Make a cash-flow plan to pay costs until payments arrive; the pre-financing usually does not cover the full budget.
gaps.budgetApproval: Find out how and how fast you can get a council decision for the application and the co-financing.
gaps.twinCity: Revive your twin-town relationship, or contact European municipalities to find partners.
gaps.network: Join a European network such as the Covenant of Mayors; networks make it easier to find partners.
gaps.localStakeholders: Sign a cooperation protocol with universities, NGOs and chambers; many programmes ask for local partners.
gaps.strategicPlan: Link the project to your strategic plan; for climate and energy projects, prepare a climate action plan (SECAP).
gaps.concreteNeed: Write the problem, the target group and measurable results on one page.
gaps.data: Collect current data (statistics, surveys, indicators) that shows the need in one file.

HomePage.eyebrow: End-to-End Operating System for EU Funding Programmes
HomePage.heroTitle: From Concept to Grant Agreement: <accent>Master Your EU Projects</accent>
HomePage.heroSubtitle: Combine open call discovery, CORDIS network intelligence, AI-assisted concept drafting, evaluator scoring simulation, and consortium seat matching in one integrated platform.
HomePage.mockProject2: TWIN-HYDRO: AI Digital Twins for Hydrogen
HomePage.mockProject3: CIRC-PACK: Circular Bio Polymers for Packaging
HomePage.methodologySubtitle: Eliminate wasted person-days on doomed proposals. Progress systematically with mathematical gate filters and AI evaluations.

gates.g0Desc: Strategic alignment scoring, TRL verification, and historical baseline win-rate triage.
gates.g1Desc: Draft Excellence, Impact, and Implementation sections with EU policy alignment.
gates.g2Desc: Match optimal coordinators and partners from CORDIS profiles by centrality and topic history.
gates.g3Desc: Deep AI evaluator simulation grading against official 15-point criteria with actionable fixes.
gates.g4Desc: Final budget verification, PIC validations, and complete application submission readiness.

HomePage.modulesSubtitle: A purpose-built suite of tools designed for every phase of EU research and innovation lifecycle.

modules.m1Desc: CORDIS graph analytics, past projects, coordinator track record, and eigenvector centrality.
modules.m2Desc: Template-driven and AI-assisted concept drafting tailored to EU work programmes.
modules.m3Desc: EU policy references, impact data points, and structured evidence bank for proposals.
modules.m4Desc: Partner relationship management with 60-day stale alerts and interaction timeline.
modules.m5Desc: Stage-gate Kanban, T-6 deadline schedules, and person-day effort tracking.
modules.m6Desc: Rigorous 15-point scoring simulation mimicking official EU expert evaluators.
modules.m7Desc: Maps university patent & technology portfolios directly to matching Horizon Europe calls.
modules.m8Desc: Calculates optimal consortia balance factoring in geography, role history, and topic expertise.
modules.m11Desc: Generates complete compliant Part A & Part B draft documents with work packages and deliverables.

HomePage.cordisHeading: Build Winning Consortia on <accent>CORDIS Network Data</accent>
HomePage.cordisBody: Our network graph analytics over official European Commission funding data surfaces top coordinators and partners. Evaluate PIC codes, eigenvector centrality, and geographic consortium balances instantly.
HomePage.sampleExplainer: M1 computes coordinator history, EU contribution and network centrality per organisation from CORDIS records. Values fill with real data inside your workspace.
HomePage.audienceHeading: Built for the Entire Innovation Ecosystem

audiences.smeDesc: Accelerate EIC and Eurostars applications with minimal overhead and high evaluation scores.
audiences.uniDesc: Match research IP and patent databases automatically with open EU call topics.
audiences.consultDesc: Manage multi-client workspaces with isolated tenants, stage-gates, and fast proposal generation.
audiences.coordDesc: Coordinate multi-partner work packages, budgets, agendas, and meeting minutes effortlessly.
